title: Coordinates of the all-ones vector
statement: Let $\mathbf{1} \in \bbr^n$ be the all-ones vector. Then for every index $i \in \{1, \dots, n\}$, the $i$-th coordinate satisfies $\mathbf{1}_i = 1$.
replaced:
Every coordinate of $\mathbf{1} \in \mathbb{R}^n$ equals $1$: for each $i$,
$\mathbf{1}_i = 1$.
